theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ted_hs_integral_compare
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (τ : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)) (A₁ A₂ : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (s : Set (Euclid P)), AEStronglyMeasurable τ μ → ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖A₁ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - A₂ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) * μ s ≤ 2 * (∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖τ x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - A₁ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ) + 2 * (∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖τ x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - A₂ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ) ∧ (∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖τ x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - A₁ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ) ≤ 2 * (∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖τ x (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - A₂ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂μ) + 2 * ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖A₁ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - A₂ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) * μ s
